qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Statutory monopoly as the sole electricity transmission system operator (TSO) in Spain, operating under concession licenses. Regulated remuneration framework set by CNMC provides inflation-indexed returns on regulatory asset base, though returns on capital are legally capped at ~5.58% to 7.0%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (gate_6 = N, REJECT). Statutory monopoly as Spain's sole electricity transmission grid operator (TSO), but structurally fails the self-funding cash conversion and fortress balance sheet criteria. FY2025 capex of €1.41B exceeds operating cash flow (€1.01B), producing negative free cash flow after capex (-€394M). Net debt of €4.84B is 9.6x net income (€505.6M), far exceeding the 4.0x ceiling, while the company pays €461M in dividends funded by debt.
qualitative.evidence: Regulated 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 7.35%, governed by CNMC statutory remuneration caps (~5.58%). Free cash flow after total capex is negative (-€394M in FY2025), yet Redeia distributed €461M in dividends funded entirely through debt. Debt/NI of 10.7x (gross debt €5.39B / net income €505.6M) and net debt/NI of 9.6x vastly exceed the 4.0x limit, creating perpetual dependence on external debt refinancing.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
